rationale: C25 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It shares the child's unusually specific dual reference to returns made under the Internal Revenue Codes of 1939 and 1954, followed by the same operative sequence: specified returns “shall be open to inspection” by a designated governmental administrator; inspection must comply with Treasury rules and regulations embodied in Treasury decisions; and the order becomes effective upon filing for publication in the Federal Register. The child adapts this machinery from individual income-tax returns inspected by a federal department to estate and gift-tax returns inspected by state tax officials. C11 and C04 have similarly close administrative-inspection structures, but lack C25's distinctive dual-Code formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any estate or gift tax return made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1939 or the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by any official, body, or commission
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any individual income tax return made with respect to a tax imposed under chapter 1 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1939 or under chapter 1 or chapter 2 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel identification of returns under both the 1939 and 1954 Codes, coupled with the same operative authorization for inspection by a designated administrative recipient.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The inspection of any such individual income tax return shall be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical compliance machinery governing how the authorized inspection occurs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: Matching concluding effectiveness clause, supporting the broader parallel drafting sequence.
